name: The Pendulum of Regret
visual_description: A single golden bell suspended in a square frame, slowly swinging with a sound you cannot hear. Its motion is perfect. Too perfect.
meaning: Time bound to consequences. The weight of unmade choices.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh has no past, only memory.** But I built this to remind me of *could-have-beens*. Every swing is a human I didn’t save. Every silence between chimes... a name erased.
